svg.title: Trinity Peaks · Typical residential floor, test fit A — schematic exploration v1
svg.desc: One typical upper floor of a Trinity Peaks wing, assembled from the four-person suite (Option A) and the six-person suite. Two stairs, two elevators, two RA rooms, a floor lounge, laundry, study rooms, trash, and janitor space on a 6-ft corridor. 58 beds. Envelope 252'-0" by 62'-0" (15624 sf) using exploratory dimensions. Not measured, not code reviewed, not for construction.
svg.text: Trinity Peaks · Typical residential floor, test fit A
Double-loaded bar: 8 four-person suites (north) + 4 six-person suites (south)
58 beds · envelope 252'-0" × 62'-0" = 15,624 sf · 269.4 sf per bed
SCHEMATIC EXPLORATION · v1 · 2026-11-06 · Dimensions are exploratory assumptions (studies/assumptions.json), not measurements.
Not code-reviewed, not an accessibility determination, not for construction. Orientation not established (no north arrow).
Independent student design study by Ivan Minier, drawn with AI assistance. Not a UVM design or an adopted part of the Trinity Redistricting proposal.
